study_conditions.frame_retention: The study condition allows at most two source RGB frames resident per inspection task. Every lab scan decodes one frame, fingerprints it, and drops it before the next decode; InFlightGuard fails the build if two frames are ever alive together. The production request is additionally measured at runtime through temporary wrappers that count live Frame objects; those peaks are recorded per run as production_residency. No full frame sequence is decoded into memory or re-read from a prepared list. Viewer PNGs are derived one decode at a time after the study.
known_limitations: Low-contrast cuts (frames 102, 142) fall below the fixed 0.335 threshold at every stride; this is a detector property, not a sampling artifact.
Two-frame shots vanish entirely at stride 4, so their content has no tile in that sheet.
The rotation counterexample is kept as a recorded false negative (cut_frames stays empty); it is not corrected or hidden.
study_conditions.min_scene_guard_note: Production rejects a cut when either side would be shorter than min_scene_frames. This is a production rule, not a lab tweak.
study_conditions.quality_definition: Quality is measured against the clip's design truth: every designed boundary within the sampling tolerance. A cut is matched when a detected cut lies within sample_stride frames of it. Missing a true cut is never treated as a match.
